rationale: RAF Civil is a direct Melbourne civil contractor looking for a top experienced site/project engineer.
Ad requires at least 2+ years' experience on Australian Tier 1 projects, which Marc does not have.
Melbourne location and drainage/piling exposure are a good fit on paper, but the experience bar is explicit.
caution: Screening questions ask directly for years of experience and salary/notice, which will expose the experience gap immediately.
gaps: Drainage and piling experience noted only as "an advantage", not confirmed for Marc
mandatory_unmet: "Possess at least 2+ years experience working on Australian Tier 1 projects" (Marc has 11 months site work in the Philippines 2019 to 2020 and no Australian work experience)
apply_instructions: Apply via SEEK; screening questions ask right to work, salary, years of experience and notice period.
title: Civil Site/Project Engineer
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
What's your expected annual base salary?
How many years' experience do you have as a civil engineer?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
